data.action: 侧卧把头枕在老师膝上求摸头，金发如瀑铺散，双眼微眯流露安心满足笑意
data.camera: medium shot, intimate couple framing, soft depth of field
data.description: 夏莱办公楼一楼的明亮咖啡厅靠窗沙发座，温暖阳光晒得人昏昏欲睡。明日奈身穿软糯的露肩白色粗针毛衣，整个人像一只大金毛狗狗一样自然把脑袋枕在老师的膝盖上。柔顺如瀑的金发散铺在沙发上，享受着老师大手的抚摸其柔顺发丝，嘴角洋溢着无比安心纯真的满足笑意。
data.lighting: 全景落地窗洒下的明澈阳光与树影光斑
data.location: 夏莱阳光咖啡厅转角沙发座
data.promptProse: Afternoon sun dapples the window seat where Asuna lies sideways, her long blonde hair spilling across her ivory sweater and the cushions. She smiles with her eyes nearly closed as the short-haired teacher in a navy cardigan strokes her hair. Her head rests on his lap, and the frame includes his downward gaze.
data.title: 一之濑明日奈 · 夏莱午后的摸头撒娇
data.animaCaption: Long-haired blonde Asuna stretches along the sofa in an ivory cable-knit sweater. The seated teacher has short dark hair and a navy cardigan over a collared shirt. He strokes her hair while she rests her head in his lap.
